terms.p: A test file under tests/, compiled as its own crate, which can only see the public API of your library — the same view an outside user gets.
Optimising across crate boundaries at link time instead of one crate at a time, which lets the compiler inline and delete code it otherwise could not see.
Marking a version on crates.io so no new project resolves to it, without deleting it — existing lockfiles keep building.
